What the tiers mean

Established
Fixed by a primary document: court record, guilty plea, IG report, sworn testimony, or authenticated record.
Strong
Documented in primary records with limited interpretive distance.
Supported
Rests on pattern-based or secondary corroboration rather than a single flagship document.
